reactor.design: Stacked graphite cylindrical reactor, two muted-red bands, white-gray service panels, six evenly-spaced coolant pipes, flanged base and support ribs. Front/right/top conceptual views.
reactor.limitations: Front and right silhouettes are near duplicates; top pipe distribution differs. Procedural geometry uses explicit dimension and sixfold symmetry specification, not inferred pixel dimensions.

assembly.design: 40x36m hall, 20m high, central reactor, ring at 4.5m and 10m, side bridges, offset stairs, front console bank, right pump yard and pipe rack, entry apron and circulation.
assembly.limitations: AI cutaway concept, not measured AZ3 plan. Roof cutaway is display only. Vehicles and distant landscape are illustrative, not mandatory modeled scope.

user_preference: AZ3 style and composition take priority. Three-view-first is guidance, explicitly not a rigid gate. Procedural reconstruction required.
